strict_exporter.parent_checks: Original ContentHash for all selected original requests, plus approved supplement full SHA and exact bounded entry verification for NFRT, NeoForm and userdev parents.
strict_exporter.minecraft_checks: Existing authenticate_version_json verifies the original direct parent pin. All selected compile downloads and ordinary libraries require exact authenticated URLs, sizes and original SHA1 child identities; missing optional mappings remain absent.
strict_exporter.child_checks: Approved exact child handles preserve source-consumer order and verify their full SHA256 and byte lengths.
order: all original prepared dependency rows remain in their original sequence
runtime roots and global frozen transitive rows retain their original sequence
function order is the explicitly witnessed five older functions or two 26.1.2 functions
function classpaths, argument arrays and JVM argument arrays are copied without sorting/deduplication
joined graph steps retain the original ordered array
first occurrence controls immutable original byte snapshots; ordered consumer rows remain separate
strict_exporter.portable_sdk_binding: Emit actual selected major, a portable selection category, optional original archive URL/SHA512 and exact supplied executable length/full SHA256. Do not persist ResolvedJava.selection diagnostic paths.
strict_exporter.sdk_limit: Supplied bytes are not proof they came from the selected executable path. actual_sdk_rechecked remains false; later host must recheck the exact archive/executable and safe copy before launch.
strict_exporter.serialization_limit: DTO and immutable memory snapshots are not yet a Java LaunchContract parser or a filesystem writer. Unknown/source-built transport and authenticated library names must be explicitly adapted, not invented.

producer_model.preflight: All observations must match the exact declaration/scope, fresh engine, completed state, no cache restore, regular-file/reparse boundary and stable bounded metadata before any byte callback.
producer_model.read_completion: Callback returns supplied payload plus post-read identity/length/ancestry. Changed observations refuse before issuing a memory receipt.
producer_model.copy: Copy once into private immutable Arc bytes and rehash. Duplicate consumers retain original order and share that same immutable snapshot.
producer_model.identity_limit: Generated full SHA is an execution-output transfer identity, never a new artifact pin.
producer_model.host_limit: Observation booleans and strings are data, not proof of actual OS handles. os_filesystem_attested and native_execution_enabled remain false. A later private host adapter must obtain the facts from the actual engine/filesystem.

ignored_java_hook.cache_limit: The pinned public API does not expose complete(fromCache) as a retained receipt. The always-disabled cache manager and a sealed fresh graph must be proven at host integration; the declared-disabled boolean is not such proof.

ignored_java_hook.shape_limit: No javac-only shape test was authorized/run for this new source. Public methods/enums were checked against existing pinned API witnesses and supporting source; root must review and schedule shape validation separately.
